id: \bThis area is blocked off after what Eternatus did.
en: \bThis area is blocked off after what Eternatus did.
it: \bQuest'area è stata chiusa dopo quello che ha fatto Eternatus.

id: \bIt's dangerous up there. I'd stay back.
en: \bIt's dangerous up there. I'd stay back.
it: \bLassù è pericoloso. Io starei indietro.

id: \bRaihan uses Dragon type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Dragon, Ice, and Fairy types.
en: \bRaihan uses Dragon type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Dragon, Ice, and Fairy types.
it: \bRaihan usa Pokémon di tipo Drago. Sono deboli contro i tipi Drago, Ghiaccio e Folletto.

id: \bThey are strong against Dragon. They are resistant to Electric, Fire, Grass, and Water.
en: \bThey are strong against Dragon. They are resistant to Electric, Fire, Grass, and Water.
it: \bSono forti contro il tipo Drago e resistono ai tipi Elettro, Fuoco, Erba e Acqua.

id: \rLooking for a warmup?
en: \rLooking for a warmup?
it: \rCerchi un riscaldamento?

id: \rDouble battles are a viable format.
en: \rDouble battles are a viable format.
it: \rLe lotte in doppio sono un formato valido.

id: \rPre-game time.
en: \rPre-game time.
it: \rÈ l'ora del prepartita.

id: \rWeather is a big strategy of Raihan. Are you prepared for it?
en: \rWeather is a big strategy of Raihan. Are you prepared for it?
it: \rIl meteo è una delle grandi strategie di Raihan. Sei pronto ad affrontarlo?

id: \bRose: I'm disappointed in Leon. Get out of my way. I need to change his mind before it is too late.
en: \bRose: I'm disappointed in Leon. Get out of my way. I need to change his mind before it is too late.
it: \bRose: Sono deluso da Dandel. Togliti di mezzo. Devo fargli cambiare idea prima che sia troppo tardi.

id: \bRose: You're ruining everything. The state of Galar is at stake.
en: \bRose: You're ruining everything. The state of Galar is at stake.
it: \bRose: Stai rovinando tutto. È in gioco il destino di Galar.

id: \bWant to follow in Raihan's footsteps? Learn Steel Beam!
en: \bWant to follow in Raihan's footsteps? Learn Steel Beam!
it: \bVuoi seguire le orme di Raihan? Impara Raggiacciaio!

id: \bCome back when you're ready.
en: \bCome back when you're ready.
it: \bTorna quando sei pronto.

id: \bLeon: You're the cause of the Dynamaxed Pokémon?
en: \bLeon: You're the cause of the Dynamaxed Pokémon?
it: \bDandel: È lei la causa dei Pokémon Dynamax?

id: \bRose: All for a good cause. You see, Galar will one day run out of energy unless I do something.
en: \bRose: All for a good cause. You see, Galar will one day run out of energy unless I do something.
it: \bRose: Tutto per una buona causa. Vedi, un giorno Galar resterà senza energia, a meno che io non faccia qualcosa.

id: \bI learned that the Darkest Day was actually a Pokémon. Eternatus! I've been taking Galar particles from it in order to secure the future. No one will suffer again.
en: \bI learned that the Darkest Day was actually a Pokémon.  Eternatus! I've been taking Galar particles from it in order to secure the future. No one will suffer again.
it: \bHo scoperto che il Giorno più Buio era in realtà un Pokémon.  Eternatus! Ho prelevato da lui le particelle Galar per assicurare il futuro. Nessuno soffrirà mai più.

id: \bYou're a part of this plan, Leon. I need you to catch Eternatus and keep it controlled.
en: \bYou're a part of this plan, Leon. I need you to catch Eternatus and keep it controlled.
it: \bAnche tu fai parte di questo piano, Dandel. Ho bisogno che tu catturi Eternatus e lo tenga sotto controllo.

id: \bLeon: I'll capture it. But not to control it, but to calm it down.
en: \bLeon: I'll capture it. But not to control it, but to calm it down.
it: \bDandel: Lo catturerò. Ma non per controllarlo: per calmarlo.

id: \bLeon: \PN, what are you doing here? No, it doesn't matter. I need to stop the Darkest Day. Handle the Chairman in my place.
en: \bLeon: \PN, what are you doing here? No, it doesn't matter. I need to stop the Darkest Day. Handle the Chairman in my place.
it: \bDandel: \PN, che ci fai qui? No, non importa. Devo fermare il Giorno più Buio. Occupati tu del Presidente al posto mio.

id: \bThis way leads to the battlefield. There's no battle scheduled right now.
en: \bThis way leads to the battlefield. There's no battle scheduled right now.
it: \bDi qui si va al campo di lotta. Al momento non è in programma nessun incontro.

id: \bAre you ready to battle?
en: \bAre you ready to battle?
it: \bSei pronto a lottare?

id: \bLeon: What are you doing?
en: \bLeon: What are you doing?
it: \bDandel: Che stai facendo?
